_comment: Hardware config. PE_peak and GEMM_peak are in TFLOPS. PE_utilization is a fraction (0..1) derating PE_peak (non-GEMM ops); TE_utilization is a fraction (0..1) derating GEMM_peak (tensor-engine ops). throughput is the per-cluster wall-clock budget in ms, interpreted as compute time + transfer time (omit to skip cluster splitting). Transfer time = bytes/(bandwidth*1e6) ms, with the bandwidth picked per link: bandwidth_c2c_gbs for a cluster-to-cluster data_out hand-off (on-chip), bandwidth_lpddr_gbs for cluster <-> LPDDR traffic (cluster 0's data_in read and the last cluster's data_out write). Omit or 0 a bandwidth to make that link cost no time. frequency is the clock frequency in Hz.
